title: MC Java Safety Check
summary: Checks whether your Java has the Java4Shell flaw (CVE-2026-114938) and, only if it does, shows how to fix it. Checked on your PC only; nothing is sent anywhere.

screenshots.title: Only if your Java is affected
screenshots.description: The card over the title screen: what was found, the official advisory, and two ways to fix it.
